commands.name: Bash
commands.command: playwright-cli attach --cdp=http://127.0.0.1:9333 && playwright-cli goto http://127.0.0.1:8899/ && playwright-cli snapshot

finalText:
Based on the snapshot, I can see the departure time for the Lisbon flight. Let me extract that information for you.

The departure time for the Lisbon flight is 07:45.

This is shown in the paragraph element with the text "Departure: 07:45" under the "Lisbon" heading.<tool_call>
